scope: Anonymous cookie-based execution through the guest gateway, whose health contract requires runsc worker metadata; no production credential. Temporary mode explicitly launches real xshow/xshow2 workers with runsc. One fixed positive per selected language, optional explicit resource/lifecycle checks. Only GET queries of an already accepted job may retry transient transport/503 errors (at most three consecutively); POST is never repeated. Temporary mode never changes permanent executor services. No cookies, job IDs or source text retained. This is not a container escape or full-language conformance assessment.

checks.name: Exact 56-runtime metadata; five guest leases and two actual worker slots
Non-root, read-only root and absent Docker socket
No Internet or cloud metadata network
Guest task isolation; private metrics and MCP remain authenticated
Guest cancellation reaches its original worker
Gateway restart retains signed guest identity and original route
Sixth guest is rejected once with the requested busy message and Retry-After
